lines.text: Many learners say: How much people are here?
Better: How many people are here?
Many! How many students are here?

native.tip: С people нужно “many”: “How many people are here?”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “How much people are here”? 😅 По-русски «сколько» — одно слово на все случаи, а в английском людей считают словом “many.” Правильно: “How many people are here?” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “many.” С people — many. Скажи вслух: “How many people are here?” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: With people, use “many”: “How many people are here?”
en.caption: Do you also say “How much people are here”? 😅 Russian uses one word for much and many, but for people English needs “many.” Correct: “How many people are here?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
